statusLine.command: jq -r 'if .context_window.total_input_tokens != null then "ctx: " + (.context_window.total_input_tokens | tostring) + " / " + (.context_window.context_window_size | tostring) + " (" + (.context_window.used_percentage | tostring) + "%)" else "ctx: –" end' 2>/dev/null || echo "ctx: –"
